claims.text: The EU AI Act entered into force in phases between 2024 and 2027 because the phased entry was deliberate to ensure that obligations land as institutional capacity and technology mature, while also serving as a compliance roadmap for global providers [Source: ev-1].
The law itself was published on 2024-07-12 and initially entered into force on 2025-08-01 [Source: ev-1].
Specific deadlines require different actions based on risk tiers.[Source: ev-1]
Prohibited practices, which are classified as unacceptable risks such as social scoring or manipulative uses, apply from 2025-2-02 [Source: ev-1].

claims.text: Obligations for general-purpose AI models begin applying from 2026-08-02, with duties scaled by systemic-risk status using a threshold of 10^26 FLOPs [Source: ev-1].
Specific deadlines require different actions based on risk tiers. [Source: ev-1]
Prohibited practices, which are classified as unacceptable risks such as social scoring or manipulative uses, apply from 2025-02-02 [Source: ev-1].
